Is a monthly car wash membership worth it?

If you wash more than twice a month, almost certainly. Here's the math, and the fine print, so you can decide for yourself.

The math

A membership costs the same each month however often you wash, up to once a day. Here's where it starts paying for itself at current prices, before HST:

WashPer washMonthlyPays off at
Good$12$303 washes a month
Better$16$363 washes a month
Best$20$423 washes a month

Every wash after that is free. The calculator on our packages page works it out for any number of washes.

Who it suits

  • Anyone who washes weekly or more.
  • Commuters on salted highways between Quispamsis, Rothesay and Saint John.
  • Vehicles parked outside all winter.
  • Anyone who likes vacuuming often. Members can use the vacuums once a day, even on days they don't wash.

Who might skip it

If you wash once a month or less, or the car spends the winter in a garage, single washes are probably cheaper.

How it works

Sign up at the wash and an attendant puts a small RFID tag on the inside of your windshield. The scanner reads it as you pull in, so there's nothing to show or pay. The membership belongs to the vehicle, so anyone who drives it can use it.

The fine print

  • One vehicle per membership.
  • Valid for one month from the date of purchase, and renews automatically.
  • Cancelling needs at least 20 days' notice before your billing date.
  • Changes are made on site, not by phone or email.
  • One wash per day maximum.

Ways to pay less

Pay three months up front and save over three separate months, or buy six months and get the seventh free. Both are listed on the packages page.
